scope: Complete bilateral MSMSulc and three-stage 21-feature C-only MSMAll core APIs; no feature generation or CIFTI projection
strict_reference_scope: These core runs bind previously saved fixed-newMSM strict CPU1 reference spheres. Independent newly run same-host official CPU1 and CPU4 validation for the same prepared core inputs is complete in the separate supplemental report gpu_fresh_official_precision.public.json; that supplemental validation is distinct from the newly generated features in the ten-person surface pipeline.
timing_definition: Each complete public API wall includes input reading, registration and sphere/report writing. Imports, input/source hashing, CUDA initialization and output comparison are outside API timing. One observation on shared GPU; no stable speedup inference.
qc_scope: Report policy preserves reference geometry: MSMSulc folds L/R 2/0 match the strict original; this is not all-chain zero-fold QC

initial_gpu_load.provenance: A1 controller prelaunch observation independently reported by task owner; not retrospectively sampled

msmsulc.scope: Descriptive mean of two complete observations per version; not a population timing estimate

msmall.scope: Descriptive mean of two complete observations per version; not a population timing estimate

prior_controller_initialization_failure_.kind: private controller interpreter compatibility before any B2/A2 launch

prior_idle_check_failure_retained.kind: zero-MiB idle check stopped before B2 despite 3 MiB residual, zero utilization and no GPU0 compute processes
prior_idle_check_failure_retained.revised_idle_gate: zero compute processes and GPU utilization; no more than 16 MiB residual, exact initial load retained

memory_scope.api_peak_allocated_gb: PyTorch allocator peak externally reset before each complete API; shared by both hemisphere streams
memory_scope.api_peak_reserved_gb: PyTorch reserved allocator peak for each API; cached blocks from the preceding API can remain
memory_scope.process_peak_rss_gb: Cumulative process ru_maxrss at the end of an API; MSMAll RSS can include the preceding MSMSulc peak

privacy_scope: Scalar metrics, parameter values and program/source hashes only. Individual input/output/reference fingerprints are omitted; full integrity evidence remains private.
